access.note: Per-company paid retrieval via Telemaco / Bilancio XBRL API. No open bulk, no free API.

pagination.note: Request a company's bilancio by CF (+ year). No population enumeration.

snapshot.note: Persist the XBRL instance; parse with an XBRL toolkit against the Italian civil-code taxonomy.

parsing.notes: tipologia bilancio (ordinario/abbreviato/micro) governs which concepts exist; revenue/net_income/employees nullable for small filers. Map valore della produzione -> revenue, utile/perdita d'esercizio -> net_income, totale attivo -> total_assets, patrimonio netto -> equity. Currency EUR.

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per esercizio; map stato patrimoniale + conto economico.
mapping_rules.matching: Join on codice_fiscale to the register spine.

fixture_requirements: bilancio ordinario with full stato patrimoniale + conto economico
XBRL exercising Italian number locale in the HTML prospetto

live_test_plan.smoke: Not applicable without a paid contract — do not attempt unauthenticated retrieval.
live_test_plan.full: Behind RI_BILANCI_XBRL_API_KEY and a contract, fetch target companies' bilanci by CF; parse XBRL; normalize to financial_statements[]. For scale prefer a commercial aggregator's financial API.

blockers: Paid per document; no open bulk; no free API.
